Name: Shorter-haired Sebastian
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[size=5][b]Shorter-haired Sebastian[/b][/size]
Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.

Wanted a better looking Sebastian and his really long side-bang was awkward-looking so I reduced it on his sprite.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OeKalcM.png[/img]

You could probably find a matching portrait to go with this as I've seen several really great ones!
Or use my new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/938]Refined Sebastian Portrait mod[/url]:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KwfGWRZ.png[/img]
[size=2][i]- Will be uploaded shortly -[/i][/size]

[u][b][size=3]Instructions for SMAPI & CP:[/size][/b][/u]
. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and then [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b][u][size=3]Instructions for .xnb (no SMAPI):[/size][/u][/b]
. This mod replaces the original Sebastian.xnb sprite. Please make a backup of the original file if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i]Sebastian.xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file into the Stardew Valley folder under [b][i]Content\Characters[/i][/b] and replace Sebastian.xnb.

Thanks for downloading!
